basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and crypto miner based in Colorado. I spend my days optimizing Bitcoin mining setups and my evenings diving into new tech trends and car modifications. I have a keen interest in health and wellness, particularly in finding dietary solutions for skin conditions like psoriasis. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore various hobbies. My typical online hours are late evenings after work when I can unwind and engage with different communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer engineering with a focus on blockchain technology. Most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching through online courses and forums, as well as hands-on experience in Bitcoin mining. My interest in health and wellness stems from personal health challenges that motivated me to research dietary impacts extensively.
